name: Primordia Mastery Scaling
descriptionTemplate:
<Italic:This scaling applies only while the Primordia realm is in effect.>

Primordia scaling is applied after a Posse's normal effect is calculated. That base effect may already include {Forbidden Lore}, {Astral Reign}, or other regular Posse scaling.

{Primordia: Chaos} Mastery applies an additional bonus to affected Posse effects based on Final Realm Mastery. Effects are divided into two scaling groups.

Utility effects gain +0.05% per Realm Mastery:
Shield, HP Recovery, {STR▼}, Crit. Rate, Crit. DMG, DMG Amplification, Realm Mastery, Aliemus, {Embryo Fusion}, and Keyflare.

Offensive effects gain +0.1% per Realm Mastery:
{Poison}, {Counter}, {STR}, {Tentacle DMG}, and {Ancient Embers}.

If every Awakener in the lineup is {Chaos}, these Primordia bonuses are doubled to +0.1% and +0.2% per Realm Mastery respectively.

Final effect = ceil(Base effect x (1 + Primordia bonus)).
